name: Polymarket BTC executable outcome quote
description: Full-replacement executable best bid, ask, midpoint, and most recent trade for both native Polymarket outcome tokens in one bound market generation. No cross-market value survives a market_transition boundary. Ready output requires a ready rules card, two-sided native quotes for both Up and Down, and a most recent trade; it never substitutes complements or values for a missing native outcome book. While the venue is alive — any book, quote, trade, or contract input admitted within staleness_bound_ms (10000 ms) — an unchanged resting book republishes its held quote values and stays ready, while a genuinely silent venue and every integrity fault (crossed or invalid quote, missing outcome book, market-boundary rule) still degrade unchanged. quote age uses monotonic receipt time. Decimal values are rounded to at most eight places using round-half-to-even.
